name: n8n-agents
description: Five n8n workflows for one fictional SaaS company, each with human approval, code guardrails and evals that block bad changes.

scripts.setup:all: node workflows/lead-router/setup.mjs && node workflows/invoice-processor/setup.mjs && node workflows/support-triage/setup.mjs && node workflows/ops-report/setup.mjs && node workflows/onboarding/setup.mjs
scripts.evals:all: node workflows/lead-router/evals/run.mjs --label candidate && node workflows/invoice-processor/evals/run.mjs --label candidate && node workflows/support-triage/evals/run.mjs --label candidate && node workflows/ops-report/evals/run.mjs --label candidate && node workflows/onboarding/evals/run.mjs --label candidate
scripts.gate:all: node workflows/lead-router/evals/gate.mjs && node workflows/invoice-processor/evals/gate.mjs && node workflows/support-triage/evals/gate.mjs && node workflows/ops-report/evals/gate.mjs && node workflows/onboarding/evals/gate.mjs
